newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing
prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said trading was slow, with lending volume down sharply with the approach of a new treasury bond issue.
The Finance Ministry has said it will issue 20 billion yuan worth of seven-year T-bonds starting November 1.
"State banks have lent out little money in the past two days due to the approach of the new bond issue," said one trader.
Short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, were major traders today, traders said.
Traders believe the new bond issue will continue to support market rates in the next few days.
